title: Open another grilling agent during a live session
story: Before this story a live session had exactly one grilling agent. Now, once consent is ticked, the meeting panel shows a Grilling agents card listing the session's grilling agents with their channel state, and an 'Open another grilling agent' control that opens a second grilling agent in its own tab, in the same session. Two agents never grill the same ticket, and the Record switch drives one shared microphone from any tab.

checks.criterion: The control opens a second grilling agent tab in the running session
checks.steps: Open a made-up project with at least two open stories. Press Start meeting. Tick consent. Press 'Open another grilling agent'.
checks.expected: A second tab opens with its own Open channel switch; the Grilling agents card on both tabs lists two agents, the new one with a New badge until its channel opens; no second session is started.

checks.criterion: Both agents receive the transcript only while their own Open channel switch is on
checks.steps: With two grilling agent tabs, turn Record on, turn Open channel on in tab 1 only, say a sentence, then turn it on in tab 2 and say another.
checks.expected: Tab 1's agent receives both sentences; tab 2's agent receives only the second; each line arrives once.

checks.criterion: One microphone per session across grilling agent tabs (review fix)
checks.steps: With two grilling agent tabs, turn Record on in tab 1, turn it off in tab 2, then on again in tab 2, then off in tab 1.
checks.expected: No error at any step; the microphone indicator goes off when Record is off; the transcript never shows a line twice.

checks.criterion: Two grilling agents never work the same ticket
checks.steps: With two grilling agents in one session and two open stories, let both agents pick their next ticket.
checks.expected: Each agent works a different ticket; asking one to jump to the ticket the other holds is refused with a message that another grilling agent holds it.
